title: Correct security and privacy knowledge guidance
summary: Security and privacy knowledge articles were corrected to align with current Business Central APIs and behavior, including fixes for SecretText HTTP guidance, error telemetry semantics, field data classification, and consent handling.
key_points: SecretText HTTP guidance now uses HttpRequestMessage.SetSecretRequestUri with HttpClient.Send instead of an API that does not exist
Error telemetry guidance realigned with AA0231 and current RT0030 behavior for Label/TextConst versus dynamic first arguments
Corrected field data classification, Privacy Notice registration and consent for custom integrations
SecretText.Unwrap is described as on-premises only, and intentional ValidateTableRelation = false handling is clarified
Fixed secret interpolation and gated BC 23/24 APIs accurately
